messages:
Aisha: Heads up, tenant 'fenrir' is reporting SCIM 401/403s after last night's RBAC role-map rollout. IdP logs show OIDC aud validation failing for client_id=fennrir-web-1 (typo in older config?)
Jon: I rotated the oauth client (new client_id + secret) during the maintenance window to retire the legacy creds. I didn't update the per-tenant SCIM connector for fenrir (oversight).
Ruth: KMS observed a cluster of InvalidCiphertextException errors at ~2026-03-20T02:13Z on alias/idp-main (v4->v5 promotion). Some tokens failed to decrypt during propagation.
Aisha: Audit shows a ~25s hole in the event stream during the ELB rolling change; that aligns with a bunch of SCIM retries. We now have duplicate service accounts by extId for some users.
Jon: Short term mitigation: add the legacy client into the gateway audience allowlist so SCIM requests validate, run SCIM in probe mode to capture retries, and queue a re-encrypt sweep for objects with decrypt failures.
infra-bot: gateway config updated by infra-bot: `gateway.audience.allowlist += fenrir-web-legacy`
kms-bot: Re-encrypt sweep scheduled for keys with decrypt failures. Alert INF-KMS-12 created for InvalidCiphertextException >= 3 in 5m.
Aisha: While debugging I grepped S3 and found a debug dump: `s3://dev-ops/fenrir/debug_dump_20260320.log` containing `oauth_client_secret` in plaintext. That debug job had overly-broad s3:PutObject permissions.
Jon: Immediate actions: 1) rotate the client secret and update IdP app, 2) purge the S3 object and remove older versions, 3) revoke refresh tokens for the client, 4) restrict debug job IAM to least privilege, 5) run a scan for other debug dumps.
Ruth: KMS re-encrypt finished for most objects; the InvalidCiphertextException rate dropped to baseline. Requeue processing cleared ~42 failed items.
Jon: Rolling out a coordinated config update for SCIM connectors across affected tenants. Also revoking client refresh tokens now.
Aisha: SCIM idempotency bug: current behavior falls through and creates a new user when extId lookup fails during aud mismatch -> duplicates. Patch incoming to do upsert (if extId exists, PATCH attributes instead of creating).
Jon: Quick log snippet from probe run: 
```
[2026-03-20T02:14:01Z] scim-sync fenrir: 401 Unauthorized - aud claim mismatch (client=fennrir-web-1)
[2026-03-20T02:14:04Z] scim-sync fenrir: 409 Conflict - user exists (extId=user:fenrir:789)
[2026-03-20T02:14:05Z] scim-sync fenrir: 201 Created - user (fallback-created user:user-789-dup)
```
This shows the exact window where creates happened instead of linking.
Aisha: Reconciliation plan: export suspected duplicates and merge by extId, keeping latest last_active and consolidating admin roles. Export placed at: s3://redwood-incident/fenrir/recon-1795002222.csv
Ruth: Also ran a quick S3 audit command to find other possible dumps: `aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket dev-ops --query "Contents[?contains(Key,'debug')].Key"` - follow-up scan in progress.
Jon: After secret rotation, re-encrypt, and SCIM patch, probe sync shows no new duplicates in the last 2 hours. Leaving the gateway allowlist entry for 12h and will remove after tenant confirms.
oncall: Postmortem action items captured: 
- Require coordinated rollout checklist for client_id/secret rotation (SCIM connectors, gateway, IdP)
- CI check to fail builds that upload secrets to S3 (scan for keys in debug artifacts)
- Harden IAM on debug tools and remove wildcard PutObject privileges
- Add KMS alert INF-KMS-12 and dashboard for InvalidCiphertextException spikes
- Implement a reconcile job to locate & merge duplicate service accounts by extId and last_active
- Add a runbook step: when rotating oauth clients, revoke refresh tokens and stage a short accept-legacy window on the gateway
Aisha: I'll own the reconcile job and the playbook RFC. Jon and Ruth will coordinate the rotation checklist and KMS follow-ups. Leaving thread open for 12h monitoring.
Jon: :thumbsup: I'll post a brief customer-facing note summarizing the outage and mitigation steps later today.
